Orchard Drop — licensing
=========================

Orchard Drop is an original game built for the Croft games shelf
(fun.croft.ing). Its own code, art, and sounds are first-party and are
released under the shelf's license, the GNU Affero General Public License
v3.0 (AGPL-3.0) — see the repository's top-level LICENSE file. The complete
corresponding source is the repository itself:

    https://github.com/CroftCommunity/fun

It is a genre homage to the Suika Game / Watermelon Game (drop-and-merge
fruit physics); no Suika code or assets are used.

Bundled third-party component
-----------------------------

This single-file bundle inlines the Matter.js physics engine, whose MIT
license and notice are reproduced verbatim below and are also kept in the
inline <script> header of index.html.

matter-js 0.19.0 by @liabru — http://brm.io/matter-js/
